workflow.title: Ticket Created
workflow.description: Record the verified ticket mint and source lineage.

workflow.title: Intake Capture
workflow.description: Capture the initial scope and open ToDos.

workflow.title: Shape
workflow.description: Clarify intent, decisions and consequential gaps.

workflow.title: Readiness Check
workflow.description: Check whether the inputs support a coherent draft.

workflow.title: Build Research Supervisor
workflow.description: Answer bounded questions that affect the draft.

workflow.title: Issues
workflow.description: Resolve consequential uncertainties without inventing intent.

workflow.title: Approvals
workflow.description: Record explicit owner choices for exact scope.

workflow.title: First Draft Supervisor
workflow.description: Shape the provisional draft through independent review.

workflow.title: Draft Review
workflow.description: Discuss the reviewed draft and remaining questions.

workflow.title: Draft Approval
workflow.description: Record owner acceptance of the exact draft.

workflow.title: Roadmap Creator
workflow.description: Create executable SPECs with source and verification contracts.

workflow.title: Pre-Flight Check
workflow.description: Verify approved inputs, checkout, permissions and standards.

workflow.title: Roadmap Supervisor
workflow.description: Execute approved SPECs with independent gates.

workflow.title: Roadmap Acceptance
workflow.description: Record owner acceptance of completed roadmap scope.

workflow.title: Merge Supervisor
workflow.description: Prepare the accepted integration for publication review.

workflow.title: Merge Review
workflow.description: Inspect the exact prepared integration and remaining risks.

workflow.title: Commit
workflow.description: Perform only the separately owner-authorized publication.
